name: b2b-research-market-and-account
description: For B2B product marketers, founders, ABM, sales and content teams: decide which accounts to target, which numbers you can publish, whether a draft is safe to send, and which critique points to accept. Research target accounts and build, audit or enrich ABM lists with a one account brief, probe questions and verified and unverified lists; turn reports and surveys into research assets, white papers, case studies and benchmarks with every number locked to its source; fact check every claim, screenshot and date before you publish; and judge another AI model's critique point by point to one final version.
